desc: Built on the Gold Cup legacy with a refined trigger, reduced recoil impulse, and optimized cycling to support accuracy and control under fire. Factory-configured for seamless integration with modern reflex sights, enabling faster target acquisition and improved precision in dynamic shooting environments. Undercut trigger guard, upswept beavertail, and enhanced checkered deliver a high, secure grip for improved handling and repeatable shot placement. Includes an extended magwell and performance-focused components designed to support efficient reloads and consistent operation in demanding use.
